defects.summary: Goroutines write prices[sku] to a plain map with no lock (mu only guards failed); concurrent writes race and can crash with 'fatal error: concurrent map writes'
wg.Add(1) is called inside the goroutine, so wg.Wait() can run while the counter is still 0 and return before any lookup finishes; LookupPrices returns an empty or partial map with a nil error
